meta.initial_emotion: interesting / need to write it down before it fades
meta.final_emotion: wakefulness hit me like a truck
meta.author_theory: Mentions it may be influenced by a YouTube documentary and 'manifesting it unconsciously' (kept as author's note).

qualities.raw_description: Underground tunnel with a flea market set up; 'single long outdoor canopy' running the whole length of the tunnel 'off into nowhere'; very dark except 'single bulbs on a string' lined up hanging from the ceiling; ceiling 'very low'; bulbs sometimes looked 'crushed to the ceiling through the fabric'; 'dirty water up to the ankles' on the ground; no remembered bad smell; long wall piled with stuff and old antiques; later heard 'talking above me and footsteps'.

boundaries.description: The canopy/tunnel 'went off into nowhere' (end not reached/visible).

interactions.description: Browsing along the long wall piled with stuff and old antiques with a man described as a buddy of 2 years (in-dream).

entities_involved.description: Guy never met in real life; in dream he was my buddy of 2 years.

interactions.description: The man addressed a little girl: 'hey Abby I found you an old video game, you might like this' and handed over a small wallet-like case; the dreamer grabbed it instead; after grabbing it, the man and the girl were gone and the dreamer was alone holding the case.

entities_involved.description: Same male companion; referred to the girl as his daughter.

interactions.transaction_item: wallet-looking small case described as an 'old video game'

interactions.description: Opened the fake leather case; inside was 'like a cassette tape but kind of round like a disc'; the dreamer felt 'very confused'.
Tried to find something to slide the disc/cassette-like item into to see if it would work; could not find electronics beyond maybe a hair dryer or a toaster.
interactions.transaction_blocker: No suitable electronics/devices available in the environment (only possibly a hair dryer or toaster).

interactions.description: Continued moving down the tunnel wall looking at piled items while standing/walking in ankle-deep warm dirty water; heard talking above and footsteps.

extraction.extraction_notes: No explicit transitions to other locations were described; the 'talking above' suggests an upper level but no new location is entered. Light temperature (warm vs cold) not explicitly described; lighting described as dim with single bulbs on a string.
